Package it.unipd.nonsense.controller

Class SyntaxTreeController

java.lang.Object
it.unipd.nonsense.controller.SyntaxController
it.unipd.nonsense.controller.SyntaxTreeController
public class SyntaxTreeController extends SyntaxController
Controller for the syntax tree visualization view. Extends the base SyntaxController to provide specialized functionality for displaying and managing dependency parse tree visualizations.
